_comment: Coding agents under evaluation. Each value is a shell command run with cwd set to an ISOLATED, disposable git copy of the task's workdir (the runner git-inits it so agents that require a trusted repo are satisfied). Env available: $PROMPT (task.md contents), $TASK_DIR (task root, e.g. for solution/), $TASK_ID. The command makes the fix in-place in the cwd. Real-agent runs spend real API quota/time and are OPERATOR-ON-DEMAND only (never CI, never scheduled). Model selection is left to each CLI's own config. The two mock-* agents apply/skip the known fix so the harness itself is validated at $0.
_codex_note: codex's built-in bubblewrap sandbox needs user namespaces, which are disabled on rogueone/mother, so a plain `--sandbox workspace-write` codex can reason the fix but cannot WRITE it. The runner already externally-sandboxes each run in a throwaway git rundir, so the correct invocation here is `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` — the flag codex documents as 'intended solely for environments that are externally sandboxed', which this is. Run it in an operator terminal; a background Claude Code session's safety classifier blocks that flag by design.
